title: ScimEvent
description: Normalized SCIM 2.0 directory event accepted by the bOPEN IdP bridge v1.0.0. Governing artifacts BOPEN-IDP-001 section 10 and BOPEN-P2-001 section 12.5. Raw broker payloads and bearer tokens are prohibited.

tenant_id.description: Exact owning tenant; never inferred from email domain

resource_id.description: Broker/provider resource reference; never a bOPEN Principal ID

email_normalized.description: Profile snapshot only; never establishes identity equivalence

active.description: Provisioning signal mapped through membership policy

groups.description: Group external identifiers; no authorization effect unless mapped

sequence.description: Provider version or monotonic observation counter for ordering guard
